page.overview:
Who is T'Jbang?

T'Jbang is the G.I. Joe Team's ninja swordsman. His real name is Sam LaQuale, and he was born in East Greenwhich, Rhode Island. A former member of the Arashikage clan founded by Storm Shadow, who is also his second cousin, and the only other person who knows the reasons behind his self-imposed oath of silence. He has crafted his own personal sword, for he was Onihashi's pupil, designed for his secretive "Silent Backslash" technique inspired by the bats' flapping. T'Jbang is also skilled in piloting helicopters when he is not in deep meditation.

In the DiC animated series, T'Jbang appears alongside other ninja force members in the episode in which Night Creeper Leader, Slice, and Dice, seek out an ancient sword.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

T'Jbang was introduced in 1992 as part of the Ninja Force subset of A Real American Hero toys. ----
